answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each new agent to win attestation from established peers and lock a refundable stake before transacting. Like a vine that climbs only where the ridge supports it, a fresh identity gains no voting weight until trusted neighbors co-sign its creation. Each sybil clone must front real stake and earn attestations, so an attacker pays as much per fake identity as a genuine one. The old fable of spawning cheap sock-puppets to swamp a vote collapses; stake is slashed on detected collusion, so the ridge of honest work stays costlier than fraud.
